description.value: An ice cream window located within the Union Steamship Co. Marina complex in Snug Cove, Bowen Island — a historic boutique marina resort just minutes from the ferry terminal. Cyclists arriving on Bowen Island by ferry would pass directly through Snug Cove, making this a natural first or last stop on any island ride. The broader marina complex also includes a boardwalk Company Store stocking local souvenirs and a well-stocked Chandlery.
